summary.tldr: Requires the Environment Minister to develop a national strategy for fresh water, report to Parliament within two years, and trigger a later review.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of the Environment to develop a national strategy for the conservation, protection and use of fresh water with provinces, municipalities, Indigenous groups, scientists, researchers and civil society groups.

Sets topics for the strategy, including drinking water standards, freshwater issues in international agreements, water and wastewater infrastructure, eutrophication in lakes, freshwater biodiversity and groundwater knowledge gaps.
Requires the minister to hold at least one conference with the people and groups involved in developing the strategy.
Requires the minister to table a report setting out the strategy in both Houses of Parliament within two years after royal assent, then post it on the Environment Department website within 10 days.
Requires a parliamentary committee to review the strategy within five years after the report is tabled and to report back with any recommended changes.
